nodes.dosc.text.t: Dobrogost takes the bottle from under your nose and puts it back on the shelf. "That's enough for you, boy. You'll fall asleep under my counter next, and I'm not hauling you to the barracks. I'm old and I've only got the one back."

nodes.kaptur.text.t: The quartermaster turns the hood over in his fingers, looks at the seams and smacks his lips. "A hunter's hood, and good work. Whoever stitched this sews better than our seamstress. I'd not price it a groat higher for you, seeing you're one of ours, nor a groat lower, since it's not my purse."

nodes.lyk.text.t: Dobrogost takes a cloudy bottle off the shelf, pours a mug and eyes it to make sure it isn't too much. "To my health. And to yours, but that one's on your bill." It burns your throat like the devil, but your belly warms up and your tongue loosens by itself.

nodes.plotka_ok.text.t: The quartermaster glances both ways, drops his voice and leans over the counter. "The one in the red cloak? Before he rode on, he quizzed me about the roll of pupils, like he was buying piglets by weight. I said nothing, and you heard nothing."

nodes.plotka_zle.text.t: "Courier? What courier? I've stood here since dawn and seen nothing but mugs that don't buy a thing." He snorts and goes back to his counting. Like getting blood from a stone.

nodes.powitanie.options.[targ].text.t: Knock a few groats off, old man.

nodes.powitanie.text.t: Dobrogost gets up from behind the counter. "Well? You buying, or just fouling my air? Both cost, mind you! Never look a gift horse in the mouth, they say, but nothing here's a gift, so look all you like, and pay."

nodes.rozmowa_dalej.options.[targ].text.t: Knock a few groats off, old man.

nodes.rozmowa_dalej.text.t: Dobrogost drums his fingers on the counter. "Well, anything else? Time's wasting, and the goods won't sell themselves, damn it."

nodes.targ_ok.text.t: Dobrogost wheezes, squints one eye and counts something off on his fingers. "Pah, you must've been born at a fair! Fine, I'll shave a bit off everything, only not a word to anyone, or they'll beggar me." He spits in his palm and holds it out to shake on it.

nodes.targ_zle.text.t: "Knock the price down?! My bandages are like my own children! Clear off with your fancy notions, or I'll charge you for the talk as well!" He winces like a man with a toothache and pushes his purse deeper inside his coat.
